name: Tazeem
description: Tazeem is one of the seven continents of Zendikar, where floating hedrons obscure the sunlight, home to most of Zendikar's merfolk and to the city of Sea Gate.

bio.text: During the Rise of the Eldrazi, a tectonic plate shambled toward a narrator's equipment cache in Tazeem, and in the southern hedron-fields the hedrons rose and runes were found to describe an Eldrazi prison.

bio.text: In Battle for Zendikar, Noyan Dar and the roilmages demonstrated the Roil against an Eldrazi herd on Tazeem, and Kiora landed on an island there still clutching Thassa's bident.

timeline.summary: The archangel Iona destroys the Tazeem Skyclave, ending the Makindi reign and creating Emeria.
timeline.quote: The Makindi reign ended when the archangel Iona destroyed the Tazeem Skyclave

citation.text: "Tazeem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The narrator learns a tectonic plate is shambling toward their main equipment cache in Tazeem, dooming it.
timeline.quote: now I hear there's suddenly a tectonic plate shambling its way across the area

citation.work: The Look of an Awakening World
citation.text: "The Look of an Awakening World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Feb 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: In Tazeem the hedrons rise and a living hedron-creature attacks.
timeline.quote: the enormous hedrons that lay dormant in the fields for centuries have begun to wrench free of the earth.

citation.text: "Booster Quest: The Shaman's Orb". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The protagonist defeats the kor artificer in a duel and learns of the amber orb and the shaman client.
timeline.quote: She tells the story of how a client once gave her a fragment of glossy black material, obsidian in color but otherworldly in texture, and told her to build a prison for it.

citation.text: "Booster Quest: The Shaman's Orb". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Novablast Wurm incinerates the kor artificer and is then defeated.
timeline.quote: there is a horrific, ground-shaking roar, and the kor woman is incinerated in a flash of light.

citation.text: "Booster Quest: The Shaman's Orb". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The minotaur turns on the protagonist and strikes a crushing blow.
timeline.quote: He attacks you, swinging his war maul and landing a crushing blow, hurling you into the air like a limp doll!

citation.text: "Booster Quest: The Shaman's Orb". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The illusion is dispelled and the minotaur is revealed to be the dragonmaster shaman, who wants to kill a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: The image of the minotaur and his war maul crumbles away, revealing a human woman, a fierce-looking shaman carrying a mystic staff.

citation.text: "Booster Quest: The Shaman's Orb". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The protagonist destroys the shaman's staff.
timeline.quote: You summon forces of nature to destroy the staff

citation.text: "Booster Quest: The Shaman's Orb". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The shaman summons an ancient Zendikari dragon while the protagonist summons creatures.
timeline.quote: The two of you square off, mage to mage.

citation.text: "Booster Quest: The Shaman's Orb". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The protagonist calls on Zendikar's elementals and defeats the dragonmaster.
timeline.quote: The dragonmaster—and her vendetta against you—lie defeated.

citation.text: "Booster Quest: The Shaman's Orb". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: An Eldrazi rises from the cracked orb and is defeated, revealing the hedron runes describe an Eldrazi prison.
timeline.quote: You defeat the horrendous Eldrazi creature, saving the continent of Tazeem from its destruction.

citation.text: "Booster Quest: The Shaman's Orb". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch is formed on a cliffside overlooking Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: The formation of the Gatewatch occurred on Tazeem

citation.text: "Tazeem", section "Rise of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiora planeswalks to Zendikar still clutching Thassa's bident, which dries to coral.
timeline.quote: There, still clutched tightly in both hands, was the weapon of a god.

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora finds a beach of grey Eldrazi dust and senses dead places across the sea.
timeline.quote: Eldrazi in the oceans!

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Angered, Noyan insists on a practical demonstration, and the group travels to Tazeem to find an Eldrazi herd.
timeline.quote: "A practical demonstration is in order," Noyan said. "I insist."

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi swarm toward Gideon and Noyan while the initiates spread in a wide circle.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi slowly began swarming in the direction of Gideon and Noyan

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: The initiates work the circle while Noyan gathers irritation into the Roil as Gideon holds the Eldrazi at bay.
timeline.quote: the large circle of earth surrounding Gideon and Noyan began to rotate in one direction and then the other.

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Noyan unleashes the Roil, collapsing the ground into a chasm that kills the Eldrazi horde and drops Gideon with it.
timeline.quote: Noyan cast his spell.

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis flies to Tazeem and Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: I unfurled my wings.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: young caravan captain Tazri halts Mahir's caravan on Tazeem because something feels wrong.
timeline.quote: "Halt!" Tazri raised her hand

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Tazri and Romoe find six dead vampires and a dying angel who begs to be killed.
timeline.quote: Please. Help me. End. Me.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Tazri kills the angel despite warnings of a curse and takes her halo, losing something unnamed in herself.
timeline.quote: She reached down to take the dull gray halo from the angel's eyes.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: On the cliffs of Tazeem the four pledge their oaths, founding the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Gideon, Jace, Chandra, and Nissa pledged their oaths to protect not only Zendikar but the entire Multiverse from threats too great to face alone

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Formation on Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A landmark of Tazeem walked away.
timeline.quote: The last reliable landmark in Tazeem just walked away.

citation.text: Dread Statuary (Conspiracy: Take the Crown, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After the Eldrazi overran Bala Ged, Jori En fled with Kendrin to Tazeem; Kendrin died before reaching Sea Gate.
